evidence: Test whether constant-zero defaults on unobserved selectors prevent reset from reaching the fitted caller. Enumerate both constant polarities only at selectors absent from the local fit.
limitations: Fitted selectors, flag timing, and unknown-flag fallback are held fixed.
Free selectors are constant-input hypotheses, not named physical signals.
One fixed index is used at every dispatch site within each run.
A chosen trace is the first clean caller-reaching example in documented order, not a hardware-confidence ranking.
Failure to reach the caller in this finite sweep is not proof that every possible completion fails.
